name: PlasterWallBroken
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.381

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: PlasterWall with the same trowel and crack layout, plus flaking and patched plaster from Poly Haven rough_plaster_broken and areas where the plaster has fallen off the rubble stone behind (stone_brick_wall_001), with a broken 12 mm edge and stained margin. A dressing variant to blend into PlasterWall by vertex colour or mask on a few modules, not for whole rooms
known_weaknesses: third pass: the fallen areas now read as lime-stained backing and flaking rather than dark pits, but they repeat as landmarks at 4x4 and the backing is stone, not lath: a dressing variant for single modules
wall_grime_mask: non-tiling in V (0 floor, 1 ceiling), tiles in U; R damp at the base (darken x0.7, tint green-brown, roughness -0.15, or blend to the Damp/Broken variant), G soot under the ceiling (multiply toward 0.25 grey), B drip streaks
